title: zconf
description: This help patch does not document a standalone `zconf` object; it presents a family of Zeroconf networking objects: `zconf.domains`, `zconf.meta`, `zconf.service`, `zconf.browse`, and `zconf.resolve`. They support browsing domains and services, registering services, and resolving services to networking parameters, but the behavior of `zconf` itself cannot be determined from this patch.
